# China Xi'an Tour

> > Your comprehensive guide to Xi'an and Silk Road travel, featuring the Terracotta Warriors, ancient city walls, and Central Asian adventures.

China Xi'an Tour specializes in cultural and historical tourism throughout Xi'an, China's ancient capital, and along the historic Silk Road route extending into Central Asia. The site offers detailed attraction guides, tour packages, and travel resources for exploring UNESCO World Heritage sites, imperial tombs, Buddhist temples, and multi-day expeditions across Xinjiang, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan.

## Key Topics

- Terracotta Warriors and Horses Museum
- Xi'an City Wall
- Silk Road
- Shaanxi History Museum
- Big Wild Goose Pagoda
- Xi'an Muslim Quarter
- Bell Tower and Drum Tower
- Central Asia Tours
- Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan Travel
- Imperial Tombs
- Buddhist Temples and Pagodas
- Kashgar and Xinjiang
- Historical Sites
- Multi-day Cultural Tours
